/* DROP SCRIPT

DROP SECURITY POLICY [RLS_SYN].[POL_SYN]
DROP FUNCTION RLS_SYN.AccessPredicate
DROP SCHEMA RLS_SYN

*/


CREATE SCHEMA RLS_SYN
GO

-- Creation of security function.
-- Function to define what will be use as filter on tables
CREATE FUNCTION RLS_SYN.AccessPredicate(@BankID varchar(20), @SourceSystemCode varchar(20))
    RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
    RETURN SELECT 1 AS AccessPredicateResult 
FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter ref_rls
WHERE ref_rls.UserEmail = USER_NAME() AND
(
@BankID = BankID AND @SourceSystemCode = SourceSystemCode

)


CREATE SECURITY POLICY [RLS_SYN].[POL_SYN]
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_SYN.AccessPredicate(BANK_CODE,SOURCE_CODE) ON [SYN].[STG_ATM_CASHBANKACCOUNT],
